newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan electronics body elects new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Japan electronics body elects new chairman.

text.p: The Electronic Industries Association of Japan (EIAJ), an influential electronics industry group, said on Friday that Toshiba Corp chairman Fumio Sato had been elected as the new chairman.
Sato replaces Sony Corp chairman Norio Oga and will serve as the head of the group of 570 electronic makers for two years until March 31, 1999.
One of the EIAJ's goals this year is to promote sales of digital video disc players, Sato said.
"Sales of DVDs are slower than we expected when the format was unified," Sato told a news conference.
"A lack of content is one major reason behind the slower-than-expected sales," Sato said.
